    Name ="tblCustomers"

    Alias ="CustomerLabel"

    RightTable ="tblWidgetOrders"
    Expression ="tblCustomers.CustomerID = tblWidgetOrders.CustomerID"
    Flag =1

    Expression ="tblWidgetOrders.OrderDate"
    Flag =1
End
Begin Parameters
    Name ="[Forms]![frmWidgetOrder]![txtFrom]"
    Flag =8
End
